types_and_nullability.candidate.rejection_reasons: array of unique values from RejectionReason: missing_geom_json, version_gate_filtered, low_precision_score, vision_only_unverified, unsupported_file_type, external_service_unavailable, or tool_unavailable
types_and_nullability.rejection_reasons: array of unique values from the same RejectionReason vocabulary
types_and_nullability.human_decision.state: reuse, revise, new, reject_candidate, need_more_info, or null
types_and_nullability.human_decision.decision_vocabulary: exact array [reuse, revise, new, reject_candidate, need_more_info]; this is a schema vocabulary, not runtime authorization or endpoint availability
types_and_nullability.submitted_decision.state: reuse, revise, new, reject_candidate, or need_more_info
types_and_nullability.submitted_decision.reason_codes: array of unique values from the existing DECISION_REASON_CODES contract
types_and_nullability.submitted_decision.idempotency_key: non-empty string with length <= 128 or null

conditional_invariants: source_job_id equals task_id and source values equal the persisted task source
task_id, task_revision, trace_id, idempotency_key, tenant_id, and schema_version equal the persisted task and immutable selector
candidate ids are unique; every candidate provenance archive_entry_id, drawing_id, file_hash, and index_receipt_sha256 match one canonical normalized receipt
the exact receipt-bound archive-exact-001 candidate is present; zero candidates or an unknown candidate is invalid
candidate.state equals candidate.verification.verdict and follows the canonical score_mapping_ruleset preimage rather than the supplier result bucket or verdict
for this ratified ER3 run semantic and geometric scores and normalizations are null, visual is finite and non-null, and visual normalization is dedupcad-vision-l2-cosine-v1
for this ratified ER3 run verification.status is unverified and reason_code is vision_only_unverified because deterministic geometry is unavailable
uncalibrated requires null confidence score, band, source_dimension, and method; confidence.verified false; null calibration version and digest; and non-null reason codes
calibrated requires non-null confidence score, band, source_dimension, method, calibration version, and calibration digest
evidence has exactly one item per candidate in candidate order and every source_digest equals the candidate search_response_sha256
rejection_reasons is the sorted unique union of candidate rejection reasons
unsupported_states contains exactly the candidate ids whose state is insufficient_evidence or whose verification.status is unverified
pack provenance values equal the persisted evidence context and source values, including both runtime receipt digests
provenance.run.repository_commit equals both repository heads in the canonical runtime-preflight receipt and that receipt proves clean status plus the owner-reviewed command digest
human_decision.state is null exactly when human_decision.submitted is null; otherwise state equals submitted.state
submitted_decision.evidence_pack_sha256 equals the prior reviewed pack digest, not the current decided pack digest, and reviewed_revision is less than the current decided task revision
submitted decision idempotency key and digest are both null or both non-null
evidence_pack_sha256 equals canonical_sha256 of the complete pack after removing only evidence_pack_sha256

ordering.verification.methods: vision-l1-phash then vision-l2-faiss then any later evidenced methods

live_success_invariants: the golden objects are serialization vectors only; a live receipt is built from observed values and never copied from a golden preimage
live SHA-256 and source-revision fields reject all-zero values, one-character repeated values, and values not recomputed from their named canonical preimage or observed artifact
live vision image/source/manifest/ruleset values equal ratified_run_bindings while platform, container, Docker endpoint, timing, and repository commit remain observed
the live search, identity, runtime-preflight, and runtime-seal preimages are exported as named artifacts and the run summary binds each artifact digest
human decision submission remains unavailable unless a separate owner action enables it; decision_vocabulary is not an enablement signal

evidence.summary: L1/L2 visual match; deterministic geometry unavailable

limitations: The golden vector and provenance receipt goldens freeze serialization and digest semantics, not model quality or observed runtime values.
The ER3 runner never enables or submits a human decision.
A non-null submitted decision remains governed by the existing HumanDecision and decision-CAS contract.
